title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: Runner Vision, bloom and a flow bonus; its autopilot finishes the course in 62 s.

verification.notes: Stands on the start roof (gloved arms); sprint reaches and passes the first red block by 5 s. Red lattice mast with electrical box (ref-2), orange-banded offices (ref-1). Autopilot finishes in 62.08 s in real Chrome; 39 physics checks and a 32M-tick fuzz run pass.
